title: 零样本可视化：用用户提示轴探索文本语料库
summary: 该研究提出零样本可视化（ZSV）任务，用户用自然语言指定概念，将文档映射到对应概念轴上进行可视化探索。研究建立了基准，比较嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计等方法，发现基于下一词概率的评分在语义忠实度、分数保真度和计算成本间取得最佳平衡，并给出端到端ZSV基线构建的实用指南。
summary_en: This paper introduces zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task where users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto corresponding concept axes for visual exploration. It establishes a benchmark comparing embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation, finding that next-token probability scoring offers the best practical trade-off across semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost, and provides practical guidelines for building end-to-end ZSV baselines.
